subject: Startups
title: Uber's Ride Credit Loop
description: A quick win: understand Uber's Ride Credit Loop.

hook.text: Uber gave new users a free ride. It also gave existing users a free ride for every friend they referred.

buildup.text: Each city launch started with free ride credits. The goal was to build a critical mass of riders fast.

discovery.text: Referral codes spread through social media. College students shared codes in dorm group chats by the hundreds.

twist.text: Some people abused the system with fake accounts. Uber had to build fraud detection just for referral gaming.

climax.text: Despite fraud costs, the referral program drove Uber's city-by-city expansion across 70 countries in under 8 years.

punchline.text: A free first ride is cheaper than a billboard.
